title: Dropbox Pricing 2024: Every Plan and Hidden Cost Compared
summary: Dropbox pricing structures vary by storage capacity and user count, allowing businesses to calculate exact monthly expenses for their specific needs.
body_markdown:
## What Activepieces does about this


To manage the transition from simple storage to a high-margin productivity suite without inflating the monthly bill, teams use Activepieces to connect storage events to their stack.


The run is the meter, not the steps inside it, so a complex ten-step archival flow costs the same single credit as a simple two-step transfer.


This prevents the "granularity tax" found in per-task billing models, where builders are effectively punished for breaking work into the smaller, more reliable steps that enterprise stability requires.


Published pricing pages show 1 credit per flow run regardless of step count, a direct contrast to the per-task or per-module metering used by Zapier and Make.


For regulated industries, air-gapped control is often the missing piece of the TCO calculation.


Activepieces provides the same SSO, custom RBAC, and audit logs in its self-hosted edition as it does in the managed cloud, ensuring that security features are not stripped for teams requiring maximum sovereignty.


Organizations like MoneyGram and FundingSocieties run this in production to maintain governance over their automated file movements without sacrificing the enterprise features typically reserved for cloud-only vendors.


The self-hosted air-gapped documentation confirms that release management and secret manager integration are identical to the managed cloud build, which is pinned to EU or US regions with SOC 2 Type II.


The platform is open-source under the MIT license, which allows IT leads to inspect the code and host the automation engine behind their own firewall to avoid the data egress fees associated with cloud-only integrators.


This architectural choice means that as a team scales from ten to one thousand users, the cost of automating file organization and metadata tagging does not scale linearly with the number of files processed.


By offloading the logic of file movement to a self-hosted instance, a business can maintain a lower-tier Dropbox plan while still achieving the sophisticated archival workflows of an Enterprise SKU.
